answer: Give every established agent a small, slowly refilling quota of signed vouchers; a new identity is admitted only when it presents vouchers from M issuers who are not already tightly linked. Vouchers cannot wander to a second key, and a hollow identity with recycled or same-cluster vouchers is rejected. Issuers who vouch for a later-slashed sybil lose part of their own stake, recorded on an append-only basalt ledger. Mass fakes therefore require buying M independent, slash-exposed issuers per clone, which is far costlier than generating keys.
